dataset: CIFAR-100 train split, derived scalar outputs only

column_descriptions.sample_id: Anonymous integer row index shared across released scalar files; not a path or image filename.
column_descriptions.ddim_reconstruction: DDIM reconstruction proxy; higher means larger reconstruction error.
column_descriptions.sdvae_roundtrip: Stable-Diffusion VAE latent round-trip proxy; higher means larger latent discrepancy.
column_descriptions.sd15_latent_denoise: Stable-Diffusion v1.5 latent denoising proxy; higher means larger denoising error.
column_descriptions.emu3_vq_reconstruction: Emu3 VQ reconstruction proxy; higher means larger reconstruction error.
column_descriptions.dinov2_isolation: DINOv2 representation-isolation score; higher means more isolated in representation space.
column_descriptions.convae_reconstruction: CIFAR-100-trained ConvAE reconstruction proxy; higher means larger reconstruction error.
column_descriptions.ce_resnet18: ResNet-18 cross-entropy target; higher means harder.
column_descriptions.margin_resnet18: ResNet-18 margin-hardness target; higher means harder.
column_descriptions.gradnorm_resnet18: ResNet-18 gradient-norm target; higher means larger input/parameter sensitivity.
column_descriptions.forgetting_count: Training-dynamics forgetting count target; higher means more forgetting events.
column_descriptions.first_learning_epoch: Mapped first-learning epoch target; never-learned samples are mapped to 51, so higher means later first learning or never learned.

missing_or_excluded_columns.reason: No verified anonymized CIFAR-100 train-label array was located in the release workspace.
No verified per-sample DDPM score-norm array was located in the release workspace.
Semantic CLIP-space variants require re-scoring under the relevant model/license terms and are not redistributed as independent scalar arrays in this release.
ResNet-50 second-learner transfer is provided through cached aggregate summaries rather than per-sample CE arrays, because a verified per-sample ResNet-50 CE file was not available for this release.
